# Concero Docs

> Build the next big thing on Concero.

## Docs

- [Get started](/getting-started)
- [What is Concero?](/what-is-concero): Concero is a **fully decentralised** interoperability protocol built to facilitate secure cross-chain value and message transfers in **under 30 seconds**.
- [Router Deployments](/get-started/deployments): This page lists all CONCERO\_ROUTER\_PROXY addresses from our deployment configuration.
Use the toggle switch to view addresses for testnet or mainnet environments.
- [Sending a Message](/get-started/sending-a-message): Concero allows you to send messages from one blockchain to another using the `conceroSend` function. This enables cross-chain communication for a variety of use cases such as cross-chain token transfers, governance actions, or any custom cross-chain interactions.
- [Installation](/js-sdk/installation): First, we will install `concero-sdk` as a dependency in our project.
- [Overview](/js-sdk/overview)
- [Usage](/js-sdk/usage)
